statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-84308 affects the pure-PHP X25519 implementation introduced in phpseclib 3; phpseclib 2.0.55 does not contain that implementation. The Debian security tracker likewise identifies the phpseclib 2.x source package as not affected because the vulnerable code is absent: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-84308
